title: Second marginal of a correlated sign pair
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $-1\leq\rho\leq1$, and let $X$ be uniform on the set of sign vectors ${-1,1}^n$. Given $X$, form $Y$ by independently at each coordinate keeping $X_i$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and replacing it by $-X_i$ otherwise. For every real-valued function $f$ on the sign vectors, the expectation of $f(Y)$ under the resulting joint distribution of $(X,Y)$ equals its expectation under the uniform distribution.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function $f$ on sign vectors of length $n$
